## Code

### P2 "Start Doom" (Shell command) · Script

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash

if command -v zdoom >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  zdoom -width 640 -height 480 -warp 1
elif command -v gzdoom >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gzdoom -iwad doom.wad +map e1m1 +vid_defwidth 640 +vid_defheight 480 +vid_fullscreen false
else
  CMD="telnet doom.w-graj.net 666"
  if command -v x-terminal-emulator >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    x-terminal-emulator -e bash -c "$CMD"
  elif command -v sensible-terminal >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    sensible-terminal -e bash -c "$CMD"
  elif command -v ptyxis >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ptyxis -- bash -c "$CMD" 
  elif command -v kgx >/dev/null 2>&1; then # GNOME Console
    kgx -e bash -c "$CMD"
  elif command -v gnome-terminal >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    gnome-terminal -- bash -c "$CMD" 
  elif command -v konsole >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    konsole -e bash -c "$CMD" 
  elif command -v xfce4-terminal >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    xfce4-terminal -e "bash -c \"$CMD\"" 
  elif command -v foot >/dev/null 2>&1; then # Popular Wayland native
    foot bash -c "$CMD" 
  elif command -v alacritty >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    alacritty -e bash -c "$CMD" 
  elif command -v kitty >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    kitty bash -c "$CMD"
  elif command -v xterm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    xterm -e bash -c "$CMD" 
  else
    # if we can't get real demons maybe we can at least get nasal ones
    echo 'int main = 666;' | cc -x c -o /tmp/a.out - ; /tmp/a.out
  fi
fi
```
